title: Black Silhouettes
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Depth pass, October 16, 2026. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 640 px as one wall and at 1200 px for the labelled works. Dates and stroke counts come from data/gallery.json; collecting facts from the Gnosis token-transfer ledger for the collector's wallets (curation/research/onchain/); the artist's posts from curation/research/social/x-posts.json (May 1, 16 and July 31, 2022 airdrop posts; July 2022 chic city cat posts). No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 28 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: For ten weeks in the spring of 2022 the same formula held: one flat color, one black shape, and a ring of short wavy lines. Twenty-eight works came out of it, from a snarling cat on March 25 to a cat the size of a hill on June 2. These are the friendliest drawings nnxyz made all year, and they were made in the busiest ten weeks of the artist's life on the board, when the inks were selling, the airdrops were going out, and more than seventy works went by in a single month.

Inside the black there is almost nothing. A pair of spiral eyes, or two small X marks, and sometimes a row of jagged teeth. A spiral makes a cat dizzy or wild. An X closes an eye for good, and the same X on a rabbit, a bee and a whole crowd of heads runs through the room like a signature. The wavy lines are the other constant. They sit in the color around the figure, never touching it, and they make a still black shape hum, as if every creature here were giving off heat.

The cats and the scarecrows had a second life. On May 1 the artist told collectors that whoever held certain inks by the middle of the month would receive new work on another chain, and in July the cats became the chic city cat club, a Polygon collection of nearly ten thousand cats, one sent free to every holder and the rest offered for a single MATIC. The whole room came to the collector at once: twenty-seven of these works were sent to Jamie Thingelstad's wallet on October 16, 2022, the day after the series ended. Watch the black horizon arrive under the creatures, watch the figures turn hairy, and watch, in the last days, the black become nearly all there is.

chapters.title: Cats on a Ledge
chapters.opening: The room begins with four cats. The first arrives in March, the other three in one week of April, and between them they set every rule the next ten weeks will follow.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #49
works.text: A black cat arches over a scribbled yellow and white ground, its back one long diagonal across the square. The eyes are two red spirals in orange boxes, and the mouth is a white zigzag of teeth. Thick blue wavy lines fill the teal around it. It is the first black silhouette in the collection, from March 25, 2022, and the only one that snarls. The artist posted it to X the same day with a link to the ink, the way nearly every work in this wing was announced: a title, a number, and the address on the board. Everything that follows in the room is this cat with the anger taken out.
works.caption: A black cat arches over scribbled yellow ground, red spiral eyes boxed in orange.
works.reading: The lines around the cat are not simple strokes. Each yellow zigzag carries a black twin just below it, a drawn shadow, so the marks seem to float above the teal. The blue outline follows the whole figure, including the inside of the legs, where it turns into a row of small notches along the belly. Recorded on March 25, 2022, with 118 strokes, it is the most worked drawing in the room after the witch.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #51
works.text: The same cat lies on a black ledge with its tail up, and nothing is drawn inside it but two yellow spirals and two white fangs.
works.caption: A black cat rests on a black ledge, tail raised, yellow spiral eyes, two white fangs.
works.reading: The ledge is the first black ground in the room, and it is cut at a slant, so the cat lies on a slope. The outline is drawn in the orange of the field, and its only job is to keep the ears, legs and tail separate from the body. Thin orange and yellow wavy lines fill the rest.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #52
works.text: One day later the same cat lies on the same ledge, facing the other way. Its body is filled with yellow scribble, so the black shows only at the edges, and the cat turns from a cut-out into something lit from inside. The eyes are red targets with crosses. Set it beside the cat from the day before and the whole method of the room is visible: a black shape is a decision about what to leave out, and filling it back in makes a different animal.
works.caption: A cat on a ledge, its black body filled with yellow scribble, red crossed eyes.
works.reading: Look at where the scribble stops. It fills the body and the head but leaves the tail and the far legs black, so the cat is half fur and half shadow. The three red marks, two crossed eyes and a stitched mouth, are the only color inside the figure that is not yellow. The blue ground is the brightest field in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #53
works.text: Balanced on a black ball, a cat curls its tail over its head, with blue spiral eyes and a white saw-tooth grin.
works.caption: A black cat balances on a black ball, tail curled high, blue spiral eyes and jagged grin.
works.reading: The ball is a half circle cut by the bottom edge, and the cat's four legs meet on top of it at a single point. Inside the body a lighter square is filled with small red wavy marks, as if the lines outside had been let in. Red zigzags cover the yellow all around.

chapters.title: Three Days in April
chapters.opening: Six works in three days, April 25 to 27. The cat gives way to other creatures, a black horizon appears under them, and two are set inside a frame. On April 25 the artist also minted a drawing called 200 nifties, to mark two hundred inks on the board, straight into the collector's wallet, the first nnxyz work he was given.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #58
works.text: Two cats sit facing each other on a red ground, and between them a heart made of two black bars meets at its point. Both have yellow spiral eyes and a jagged yellow grin. Yellow lines fill the red in rings around them. Two cats and a heart is the gentlest picture in the series, and it was made on April 25, the day the artist celebrated two hundred inks on the board and sent the celebration piece to the collectors who had been paying attention. The affection in the drawing and the affection in the gesture are the same thing.
works.caption: Two black cats face each other on red, a black heart between them, yellow spiral eyes.
works.reading: The heart is not an outline. It is two straight black bars, each as wide as a cat's leg, bent to meet at the bottom, so it belongs to the same cut-out world as the cats. Each cat has its own field of wavy lines, and the two fields meet in the middle above the heart.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #60
works.caption: A creature of stacked black blocks sits on the horizon, yellow spiral eyes, jagged grin.
works.reading: The body is a pyramid of rectangles with rounded corners, two bars for arms resting on the ground and two rounded feet. Nothing in it is curved except the eyes. The olive ground and the thin yellow lines are the quietest in the room, and the creature takes up most of the width.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #61
works.caption: A black frog squats on the horizon under lime green, red wavy lines rising above it.
works.reading: The frog is one shape with nothing inside it but two spiral eyes and a grin, both in yellow. The red marks around it are short and close, drawn in red on green, and they stand up from the back like heat.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #62
works.text: Inside a white frame, a black bear hugs its round belly in the corner of a yellow square, with no wavy lines at all.
works.caption: A black bear hugs its round belly in the corner of a yellow square framed in white.
works.reading: This is the first work in the room with no wavy lines and the first with a frame. The yellow square sits inside a wide white margin, and the bear overlaps the bottom edge of the square, so it stands partly on the margin. Its eyes are two closed crescents and its mouth a stitched line, both in yellow. Thirty-three strokes, among the fewest in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #63
works.caption: A black figure with a topknot raises both arms, its round orange face spiral-eyed, framed in white.
works.reading: The figure is built from circles: a head with two round ears, a ball for the topknot, a body and two fists. The face is the one place the orange shows through the black, drawn as a circle filled with the ground color, so the eyes sit on orange and not on black.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #64
works.text: No horizon under this one. A black bird with one yellow spiral eye and a zigzag beak floats on teal.
works.caption: A black bird floats on teal, one yellow spiral eye, a zigzag beak, no ground beneath it.
works.reading: The bird is two overlapping shapes, a round body and a pointed wing, with a thin teal line where they meet. Two short black lines trail from the left edge, the only sign of motion. The yellow wavy marks ring the whole bird, above and below, since there is no horizon to stop them.

chapters.title: Scarecrows and a Witch
chapters.opening: After three weeks away, the black turns hairy. Scarecrows are drawn in bristling strokes, grass grows along the horizon, and the X mark arrives for the eyes. These are the inks the artist named in the May airdrop: hold a cat or a scarecrow, and something new would follow.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #88
works.text: On a single pole, a scarecrow holds its arms out, drawn in scratchy strokes, with grass bristling along the black horizon and every wavy line in black on orange.
works.caption: A black scarecrow on a pole, arms out, grass bristling below, black wavy lines on orange.
works.reading: Nothing here is a clean cut-out. The hat, the arms and the grass are all built from quick overlapping strokes, so the edges fray, and the wavy lines are black for the first time, which ties them to the figure. The scarecrow has no face.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #89
works.text: The scarecrow again, a day later, now standing in a field with a black cat beside a purple fence. Its face has two round yellow eyes and its body is a mass of hatched strokes. Yellow wavy marks are everywhere in the magenta. This is the drawing that gave the room's two formulas to each other: the hairy scarecrow and the flat cat share one field. The artist promised the scarecrow holders their own collection and, as late as July 31, was still telling them it had not been forgotten. The cats got their club; the scarecrows are still waiting at the fence.
works.caption: A straw scarecrow and a black cat stand at a purple fence under magenta, yellow lines everywhere.
works.reading: The fence is drawn in purple, a darker shade of the ground, so it sits behind the figures without competing with them. The cat's ears, the scarecrow's hat brim and the strands of grass all end in the same frayed stroke. The two yellow eyes on the scarecrow are the only round marks in the picture.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #91
works.text: A rabbit sits upright on red with both ears straight up, its eyes two X marks and its mouth a small zigzag, a line down its chest like a seam.
works.caption: A black rabbit sits upright on red, ears straight up, two X marks for eyes.
works.reading: The rabbit is a single clean silhouette, and the wavy lines go back to yellow. A red line runs from the chin down the chest and splits at the belly, the one inside mark besides the face, and it gives the rabbit the look of a stuffed toy. The ears are nearly as tall as the body.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #92
works.text: Dancing on one leg, a round-headed figure bends its arms, X eyes, the wavy lines black again on orange.
works.caption: A black figure dances on one leg under orange, round head, arms bent, X eyes.
works.reading: The pose is a dancer's: one knee raised, one arm up and one out, the body flaring like a skirt. The head is a plain circle with two small orange X marks. Short black wavy lines ring the figure from the ground up.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #96
works.text: A witch in a pointed hat stirs a cauldron from a step ladder, and the cauldron says SCAFFOLD ETH in scratchy pale letters. The witch is drawn like the scarecrows, in bristling strokes with one X for an eye, and sparks rise from the pot. Scaffold-ETH is the open-source toolkit Nifty Ink was built with, made by Austin Griffith, the engineer who built the board. He was one of the artist's earliest buyers, and in February 2022 he put ether into the artist's Ethereum wallet so the inks could be upgraded to the main chain. This is the one drawing in the room about where the room came from: a witch cooking the thing that made her possible, and enjoying it.
works.caption: A witch on a ladder stirs a cauldron labeled SCAFFOLD ETH, sparks rising, under lime green.
works.reading: The words are drawn in the ground color, so they look cut out of the black pot. The ladder stands on a hatched patch of ground that doubles as the witch's shadow. Her hat, hair and robe are all one bristle of strokes, and her hooked nose is the sharpest point in the drawing.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #98
works.caption: A black rabbit sits facing out on pale blue, yellow spiral eyes, black wavy lines around.
works.reading: The rabbit faces front with its paws together, a round and plain figure with long ears that nearly touch at the top. The eyes are yellow spirals, and a small yellow W makes the nose. The black wavy lines stand in a ring that opens at the ground.

chapters.title: Small Creatures
chapters.opening: The last week of May brings the small things: a snail, a turtle, a bee, a balloon, a worm, a spider, a flower and a crowd. Each gets one shape, one color and its ring of lines. Eight of them were drawn on two days, May 25 and 31.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #101
works.text: Along the horizon crawls a snail with a yellow spiral shell and a tiny cat-like face.
works.caption: A black snail crawls along the horizon under yellow, its shell a single yellow spiral.
works.reading: The spiral on the shell is the same mark that makes the eyes elsewhere, drawn large. The snail's face is a small pointed head with two tiny eyes, a line for a mouth and two little horns. The yellow lines fan out from the shell like rays from a sun.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #103
works.caption: A black turtle walks the horizon under teal, one round yellow eye and a small open mouth.
works.reading: The shell is a smooth dome and the four legs are stubs, so the turtle is almost a single oval. The yellow wavy lines rise from the shell in a fan and leave the ground clear. Thirty-four strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #106
works.text: Over the horizon a bee with X eyes hovers, while a small black flower with spiral eyes looks up at it from the lower right.
works.caption: A black bee hovers under blue, X eyes, while a small spiral-eyed flower looks up from below.
works.reading: Two creatures share the square, and each has its own ring of lines: the bee's long and loose, the flower's short and tight. The bee is two round wings over a round body with four small legs, and its X eyes are yellow. The flower is the only thing growing from the horizon.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #109
works.text: On a long wavy string a balloon with spiral eyes and a jagged grin rises, and a black hand at the bottom corner lets it go.
works.caption: A black balloon with spiral eyes rises on a wavy string, a hand at the corner below.
works.reading: The string is the longest single line in the room, bending four times on its way to the corner, where a black hand reaches up from the edge. There is no horizon and no ground, only the hand. The balloon grins with the same jagged yellow teeth as the cats. Thirty-one strokes, the fewest in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #112
works.text: Out of a bitten apple on a steep black slope rises a worm with X eyes, the lines around it black on green.
works.caption: A black worm with X eyes rises from a bitten apple on a steep slope under green.
works.reading: The slope runs from upper left to lower right, the steepest ground in the room, and the apple sits on it without rolling. The bite is a clean curve out of the right side, with a leaf and stem on top. The worm's face is three small yellow marks.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #114
works.text: From the top edge a spider hangs on a thin thread, legs tucked around a round body, three small yellow marks for a face.
works.caption: A black spider hangs on a thin thread under yellow, legs tucked, a tiny yellow face.
works.reading: The thread is a single hairline from the top edge. The spider is a circle with its legs bent close against it, like hands, so it is almost a ball. Black wavy lines surround it on all sides, with no ground anywhere.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #119
works.text: A crowd of black heads fills the bottom of a yellow square, every face a pair of X marks. The yellow sits inside a thick black border, so the square is a window and the crowd stands at its sill. Not one of them has a mouth. It is the only crowd in the room, and it comes at the end of May, when the market had just fallen and the board was full of people wondering what they were holding. The X eyes are the room's joke about being closed for good, and here there are twelve of them, all looking out of the same window, and nothing to see.
works.caption: A crowd of black heads with X eyes fills the bottom of a yellow window in a black border.
works.reading: The heads overlap in two rows, the front row larger, and the single raised fist breaks the line of skulls. The yellow panel sits a little above center, leaving a wide black band below, so the crowd seems to stand on the border itself.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #122
works.caption: A black flower with spiral eyes and a jagged grin leans on its stem, one petal fallen.
works.reading: The flower head is a ring of round petals, and the face inside it is the cat's face: two yellow spirals and a zigzag of teeth. The stem bends in from the lower right with two leaves, and the loose petal lies on the green like a dropped glove. Black wavy lines surround the head.

chapters.title: Last Days
chapters.opening: The room ends on June 1 and 2 with four works that take the formula in four directions: a figure drawn in scribble, a child reaching up, a page of tiny figures with no color at all, and one last enormous cat.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #126
works.text: Bent over two crates marked with sunbursts, a scribbled figure rests its hands on the lids, while a small snail crosses the pink at the bottom left.
works.caption: A scribbled black figure bends over two crates marked with sunbursts under pink, a snail passing below.
works.reading: The figure is drawn like the scarecrows, in hatched strokes, with a yellow X for one eye, and its shadow is a hatched patch under the crates. The crates are drawn in outline, the only objects in the room with a visible inside. The snail at the bottom edge is tiny and drawn in line, not in black fill.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #130
works.text: A figure seen from behind reaches up to a small black heart that gives off sparks. The face is turned away, and all that shows of it is one small X on the cheek. The wavy lines, black now, stand up along the arm and the head like hair on end. A child reaching for a spark is the most tender picture in the wing, and it was made on June 1, 2022, in the week the first part of the series ended. The heart is tiny and the yellow is enormous. Everything in the drawing is about the distance between the hand and the thing it wants.
works.caption: A black figure seen from behind reaches up to a small sparking heart under yellow.
works.reading: Most of the figure is below the frame, cut off at the shoulders and the raised arm, so it seems to stand just outside the picture. The sparks are short yellow lines inside the black of the heart, not around it. The X on the cheek is drawn in yellow, the same color as the ground.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #132
works.text: Rows of tiny black figures tumble across a white page, each one scribbled in a few strokes, with a single red one beside the signature.
works.caption: Rows of tiny black scribbled figures tumble across a white page, one red figure in the corner.
works.reading: This is the only work in the room with no color field and no wavy lines. Each figure is a knot of five or six strokes, a round head with ears and a body with its arms out, and no two face the same way. The red figure sits beside the signature at the lower right, drawn the same way as the others.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #133
works.text: A cat the size of a hill crouches on a black slope, filling the square from edge to edge, and looks out with yellow spiral eyes and a stitched grin. Its tail rises off the top of the picture and comes back down. The blue outline is the same as the first cat's, the spirals are the same, and nothing else is. The first cat arched and snarled at the edge of a scribbled field; this one has grown until the field is gone. It is the last silhouette, from June 2, and the calmest. Ten weeks of black shapes end with the biggest of them, at rest.
works.caption: An enormous black cat crouches on a slope under blue, spiral eyes, stitched grin, tail hooked above.
works.reading: The cat's body is one black mass joined to the ground, so there is no outline where it meets the slope. Only the blue lines on the paws and the back say where the cat ends. The ears, eyes and grin are pushed into the lower left corner, far from the center. Recorded on June 2, 2022, the last work of the room.

closing: Go back to the first cat and the last. The one from March arches and bares its teeth on a scribbled ground. The one from June fills the whole square and sits still, with the same blue outline and the same spiral eyes. Between them the room tried the formula on twenty-six other creatures and never once turned mean. In the rooms next door the eyes are lamps and the heads are skulls. Here, for ten weeks, the black shapes were simply glad to be on the block.
collectorDecisions: Collector, 2026-10-15: pilot approved as the pattern for the other rooms; the audio narration written with the text and the arc from first to last work are what the collector wants.

collectorDecisions.decision: Collector, 2026-10-16: depth pass. Market, platform, people and the collector may be named; the artist's sourced words may be read for feeling.

Ten weeks of black shapes end with the biggest of them, at rest.

Go back to the first cat and the last. The one from March arches and bares its teeth on a scribbled ground. The one from June fills the whole square and sits still, with the same blue outline and the same spiral eyes. Between them the room tried the formula on twenty-six other creatures and never once turned mean. In the rooms next door the eyes are lamps and the heads are skulls. Here, for ten weeks, the black shapes were simply glad to be on the block.
